thought.text: Composer install completed — web/ and vendor/ are in place. Let me confirm completion status and then run the site installation.

reasoning_content: Composer installation has completed — the `web` directory and `vendor` directory exist, and the autoload has been generated. The nohup background process has terminated (no composer processes running). I'll check the end of the log to confirm success, and also check the exit code. Since the log was written via nohup, I'll check the last line and confirm the final state.

action.command: tail -1 /tmp/composer_install.log; echo "==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev composer validate --no-check-publish 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "==="; ls /workspace/web/sites/default/

tool_call.name: terminal
